fields.Name: Issue Portal Magic Link
fields.Description: Issues a fresh single-use portal magic link for an existing portal session (staff-initiated, server-side token generation + hashing via PortalAuthService). Returns the raw token for out-of-band delivery to the contact.

fields.Name: SessionID
fields.Description: The Portal Session (MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: Portal Sessions.ID) to issue the magic link for.

fields.Name: MagicLinkToken
fields.Description: The raw single-use magic link token. Delivered out-of-band (e.g. emailed); never stored raw.
